# FinCon: A Synthesized LLM Multi-Agent System with Conceptual Verbal Reinforcement for Enhanced Financial Decision Making

| **task** | Sequential financial decision-making with an LLM multi-agent system, covering single stock trading and portfolio management. | “We introduce FinCon, an LLM-based multi-agent framework with conceptual verbal reinforcement for diverse financial tasks.” |
| **architecture** | Manager-analyst hierarchy: seven analyst agents (news/filings text, Whisper audio for earnings calls, data analysis, stock selection) feed a sole decision-maker manager; dual-level risk control (within-episode CVaR alerts, over-episode conceptual verbal reinforcement via textual gradient descent); memory modules. | “The agent system of FinCon consists of two main components: the Manager-Analyst Agent Group component and the Risk-Control component.” |
| **data** | Daily stock prices (Yahoo Finance), Refinitiv/Reuters news, 10-Q/10-K filings, Zacks research, earnings call audio; eight US stocks for single trading and two 3-stock portfolios selected from a pool of 42 stocks. | “We construct a market environment representation using real-world financial data, including stock prices, daily news, company filings (Form 10-Q, Form 10-K, etc.), and ECC audio from January 3, 2022, to June 10, 2023” |
| **window** | Train January 3, 2022 to October 4, 2022; test October 5, 2022 to June 10, 2023. DRL baselines trained January 1, 2018 to October 4, 2022. | “FinCon is trained from January 3, 2022, to October 4, 2022, and tested from October 5, 2022, to June 10, 2023. DRL agents are trained over the period from January 1, 2018, to October 4, 2022” |
| **models** | GPT-4-Turbo for all LLM agents at temperature 0.3 (0 for belief generation); Whisper API for audio. | “All LLM-based agents use GPT-4-Turbo, with temperature set at 0.3.” |
| **baselines** | Single stock: Buy-and-Hold, A2C, PPO, DQN, Generative Agent, FinGPT, FinMem, FinAgent. Portfolio: Markowitz MV, FinRL-A2C, Equal-Weighted ETF. | “For single-stock trading, we compare FinCon with DRL agents (A2C, PPO, DQN) and LLM-based agents (Generative Agent (GA), FinGPT, FinMem, FinAgent) as well as the Buy-and-Hold (B & H) strategy.
